result.title: CreaTrace: Video Creative Plagiarism Detection and Evidence Tracing
result.summary: Video creative plagiarism refers to the unauthorized reproduction of creative ideas across videos despite substantial differences in visual appearance, posing a new challenge to video copyright protection. However, existing video copy detection methods primarily focus on visual content similarity, struggling to capture abstract creative that are entangled with specific visual realizations. To address this issue, we introduce a novel task, named Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD), and propose an iterative creative evidence tracing framework, termed CreaTrace, to verify creative similarity and accurately localize the corresponding evidence segments. Specifically, we design a Multimodal Semantic Event Segmentation strategy to divide similar long videos into coherent narrative events, facilitating event-level dataset construction and retrieving similar segments. Based on these events, CreaTrace employs Coarse Creative Matching to identify candidate event pairs through narrative semantics and camera language. Then CreaTrace presents Creative Decoupling to disentangle abstract creative patterns from specific visual realizations. Meanwhile, Creative Swap Contrastive Learning is devised to enhance creative consistency through cross-realization feature swapping. Benefiting from the above designs, our CreaTrace enables accurate creative similarity detection and temporal localization, while providing interpretable evidence report. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of CreaTrace across diverse creative plagiarism scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 提出视频创意抄袭检测任务与 CreaTrace 框架，通过多模态语义事件分割、粗粒度创意匹配、创意解耦与跨实现特征交换对比学习，判定创意相似度并定位证据片段。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把抽象创意模式与具体视觉实现分离、并用跨实现特征交换增强不变性的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要的 latent 内容与表面视觉实现提供表示解耦线索，需核查。
